held_out.global_finger: 20s/36s before contact; grasp_open/close/lift only secondary silhouette checks
held_out.global_cube: Same repeated static source landmarks, consistency check only
held_out.wrist_finger: Same-opening train/heldout supports correlated; closing-width check is new opening

erratum: The frozen experimental fit_03/report.json generic limitation says Depth not fitted. This means wrist depth only; its explicit global_plane_constraint field is accurate: home global depth was fitted. Exported current script/report corrects this wording.
variant: fit04, adds manually annotated static blue top at34s with3px sigma

supplement.coordinate_system: Native 640x480 camera view, u right/v down, zero-based; real composite header of 32px removed; no resizing
supplement.corner_order: Existing scene local top corners [(-0.5,-0.5),(-0.5,+0.5),(+0.5,+0.5),(+0.5,-0.5)] * side, followed by scene yaw. This is physical corner order, not identical image-cyclic start across views.
supplement.annotation_method: Independent manual native-pixel blue top-face reading, checked using enlarged blue34_detail_grid.png; no fit output used to move pixel observations.

observations.name: pregrasp_34s
observations.state_source: replay.jsonl observed before command; nearest recorded UNIX timestamp
observations.cube_note: Only stationary BLUE top-face corners. Corners are slightly rounded/blurred; manually read to +/-3px. Green is excluded. Existing scene physical corner order maintained. Supplemental training frame chosen after fit03 showed near-field extrapolation residual; 20/36/41 remain held out.

supplement.append_to: Existing fit03 training data; preserve old fit inputs and holdout splits

validation_status: All validation frames excluded from optimizer; already inspected during development/variant selection, not a blind independent test set.
